data.title: Parking warning fine – €30.00
data.summary: The City of Musterstadt's regulatory office issued a warning with a €30.00 fine for parking without a valid ticket on 12 September 2026 in a car-sharing vehicle. Payment is due within one week of receiving the letter.
data.explanation: The city says you parked without a valid ticket and were named as the driver by the car-sharing company. This is a warning with a fine (Verwarnung mit Verwarnungsgeld) of €30.00. It only takes effect if you agree and pay within one week of receiving the letter, and the app shows the date. If you pay on time, the matter is closed. If you disagree or want to comment, use the enclosed hearing form (Anhörungsbogen). If you don't pay on time, a fine proceeding (Bußgeldverfahren) starts, with extra costs of at least €28.50.

items.title: Pay parking warning fee

date.text: innerhalb einer Woche nach Zugang dieses Schreibens

items.action: Transfer €30.00 to the Stadtkasse Musterstadt, quoting the Kassenzeichen as the reference.
items.consequence: A fine proceeding (Bußgeldverfahren) is started, with additional fees and expenses of at least €28.50.
items.quote: Die Verwarnung wird nur wirksam, wenn Sie mit ihr einverstanden sind und das Verwarnungsgeld innerhalb einer Woche nach Zugang dieses Schreibens auf das unten genannte Konto der Stadtkasse Musterstadt überweisen.

items.title: Optional: return hearing form if you disagree

date.text: Wenn Sie mit der Verwarnung nicht einverstanden sind oder sich zu dem Vorwurf äußern möchten, verwenden Sie bitte den beigefügten Anhörungsbogen.

items.action: If you disagree or want to comment, use the enclosed hearing form (Anhörungsbogen) instead of paying.
items.consequence: No statutory deadline is stated; without payment a fine proceeding may begin.
